- **No other record:** the shared files have nothing under a Thornbury account folder, so I suggested Dana confirm with Marcus if the tracker needs a firmer source.
- **Something to tidy up:** the summary I wrote after Marcus's message also ended up in #north-team as a separate post (14 October, 09:00). It refers to Marcus as "he", though his pronouns aren't stated anywhere. You might want to delete it.
